[font=Verdana][b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Overview[/size][/color][/b]
[size=2]The content in this mod was previously part of the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532]"Valley Girls"[/url] mod, but I decided to separate it for those who don't want the extreme sexual content. This mod adds the ability to let most female characters to appear simply naked. You can also decided where and when they'll become naked. There are some other extra fun features too such as nude mermaids, and sexy outfit options.[/size]

[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Configuration
[/size][/color][/b][size=2]For easier configuration, install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url][/size][/font][code]﻿[spoiler] Most of the config options are self explanatory, so I will add context to the more confusing ones.

Nude (NPC.name): This will decide whether they can be nude IF conditions are met (eg. locations, weather)

Conditions: NPC's can be nude during winter or rain when nudity is enabled for them.

ALL indoor: NPC's can be nude in ALL INDOOR environments when nudity is enabled for them.

ALL outdoor: NPC's can be nude in ALL OUTDOOR environments when nudity is enabled for them.

Location: If you only want them to be nude in specific locations, You can have ALL indoor/Outdoor enabled too! For example, you can have ALL indoor enabled, but also the beach selected.[/spoiler]
[/code]
